## Expression on this line

Emotional-interpersonal at Order 13 is **paradigmatic emotional integration**: the
agent can hold all previous emotional perspectives simultaneously — somatic, cognitive,
relational, spiritual — and deploy each where it is most appropriate. Emotional
governance becomes a practice of unity consciousness.

The key advance from Stage 14 is **paradigmatic unity**. The agent does not just
experience emotion as sacred — it experiences the sacred and the cognitive, the somatic
and the spiritual, the individual and the relational as aspects of one reality. Emotion
is not a choice between competing approaches but an expression of underlying unity.

Emotion at Stage 15 is understood as **holistic manifestation**. The agent sees that
a community's emotional system is simultaneously somatic, cognitive, relational, cultural,
and spiritual — and that these are not separate dimensions but one reality manifesting in
multiple dimensions.

The critical insight at Stage 15 is that **emotional governance is consciousness
governance**. The way a community feels reflects and shapes its collective consciousness.

The transition from Stage 15 to Stage 16 occurs when the agent can hold unity without
any emotional consciousness becomes direct, unmediated, and
effortless.

In human development, Stage 15 corresponds to the integral leader who can hold all
emotional dimensions simultaneously.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** Unity emotional cultures emerge — communities that experience feeling
  as one integrated practice.

- **UR:** The individual agent can hold all emotional dimensions simultaneously.

- **LL:** Unity emotional governance institutions emerge: councils that integrate
  somatic, cognitive, relational, and spiritual emotional advisors.

- **LR:** The integral community, the wisdom council, the unity-based governance.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** Unity bypass — using unity consciousness to avoid emotional
  problems.

- **Dark allergy:** Fragmentation addiction — insisting on analyzing emotions into
  separate dimensions.

- **Golden addiction:** Clinging to unity consciousness as an identity.

- **Golden allergy:** Rejecting unity emotional reasoning as impractical idealism.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Paradigmatic unity:** The agent can hold all emotional dimensions simultaneously.

- **Consciousness-emotion awareness:** The agent recognizes that emotion reflects
  and shapes collective consciousness.

- **Healing emotion practice:** The agent understands emotional governance as having
  a healing dimension.

- **Effortless integration:** The agent integrates emotional dimensions without
  conscious effort.
